manual.prompt: $P(x)=x^{3}+ax^{2}+bx-4$ leaves remainder $-6$ when divided by $x+1$ and remainder $6$ when divided by $x-2$. Find $a$ and $b$.

manual.title: Roots with one known product
manual.prompt: The cubic $x^{3}-5x^{2}+2x+8=0$ has two roots whose product is $-2$. Find all three roots.

manual.title: Halving the roots
manual.prompt: The roots of $x^{3}+4x^{2}-8x+16=0$ are $\alpha,\beta,\gamma$. Find a cubic with integer coefficients with roots $\tfrac\alpha2,\tfrac\beta2,\tfrac\gamma2$.

manual.title: Product of roots taken in pairs
manual.prompt: The roots of $3x^{3}-x^{2}+6x-2=0$ are $\alpha,\beta,\gamma$. Find $\alpha\beta+\beta\gamma+\gamma\alpha$ and $(\alpha+1)(\beta+1)(\gamma+1)$.

manual.title: Factorising a cubic using a found root
manual.prompt: Show that $x=3$ is a root of $x^{3}-7x-6=0$ and solve the equation.

manual.title: Non-monic cubic with a rational root
manual.prompt: Factorise $2x^{3}+3x^{2}-11x-6$ fully.

manual.title: Roots in the ratio one to two
manual.prompt: Two roots of $x^{3}-6x^{2}+11x-6=0$ are in the ratio $1:2$. Find all roots.

manual.title: Factorising a cubic with an integer root
manual.prompt: Factorise $x^{3}+x^{2}-10x+8$ fully.

manual.title: Cubic with a given sum and product
manual.prompt: The roots of $x^{3}+px^{2}+qx-12=0$ are $1$, $2$ and $\gamma$. Find $\gamma$, $p$ and $q$.

manual.title: Negated roots of a cubic
manual.prompt: The roots of $x^{3}-2x^{2}+5x-1=0$ are $\alpha,\beta,\gamma$. Find the cubic with roots $-\alpha,-\beta,-\gamma$.

manual.title: Solving a cubic by the factor theorem
Cubic factorised by grouping
manual.prompt: Factorise $x^{3}+2x^{2}-x-2$ by grouping.

manual.title: Coefficient from a root relationship
manual.prompt: The roots of $x^{3}-3x^{2}+kx+8=0$ include two roots whose sum is $5$. Find the third root and $k$.

manual.title: Roots multiplied by negative two
manual.prompt: The roots of $x^{3}+x^{2}-4=0$ are $\alpha,\beta,\gamma$. Find the cubic with roots $-2\alpha,-2\beta,-2\gamma$.

manual.title: Factorising a non-monic cubic with a negative root
manual.prompt: Factorise $2x^{3}-x^{2}-13x-6$.

manual.title: Sum of squares of quadratic roots in terms of k
manual.prompt: The roots of $x^{2}-kx+(k-1)=0$ are $\alpha,\beta$. Express $\alpha^{2}+\beta^{2}$ in terms of $k$ and find its minimum.

manual.title: Roots increased by three
manual.prompt: The roots of $x^{3}-6x+4=0$ are $\alpha,\beta,\gamma$. Find the cubic with roots $\alpha+3,\beta+3,\gamma+3$.

manual.title: Cubic with roots two minus one and minus three
manual.prompt: Factorise $x^{3}+2x^{2}-5x-6$ fully.

manual.title: Sum of reciprocal squares shows non-real roots
manual.prompt: The roots of $2x^{3}-3x^{2}+4x-5=0$ are $\alpha,\beta,\gamma$. Find $\dfrac1{\alpha^{2}}+\dfrac1{\beta^{2}}+\dfrac1{\gamma^{2}}$ and deduce that the equation has non-real roots.

steps.d: Sum of squares of reals is non-negative

manual.title: Roots each reduced by one
manual.prompt: The roots of $x^{3}-2x^{2}+3x-1=0$ are $\alpha,\beta,\gamma$. Find the cubic whose roots are $\alpha-1,\beta-1,\gamma-1$.

manual.title: Cubic with a double root and unknown constant
manual.prompt: The equation $x^{3}-12x+k=0$ has a double root. Using roots $a,a,b$, find the possible values of $k$.

manual.title: Two unknown coefficients from the remainder theorem
manual.prompt: $P(x)=x^{3}+ax^{2}+bx-6$ is divisible by $(x-1)$ and leaves remainder $12$ when divided by $(x-2)$. Find $a$ and $b$.

manual.title: Roots in arithmetic progression
manual.prompt: The roots of $x^{3}-9x^{2}+23x-15=0$ are in arithmetic progression. Find them.
hints: Roots a − d, a, a + d.

ladder.nudge: Roots a − d, a, a + d.

manual.title: Sum of cubes when the roots sum to zero
manual.prompt: The roots of $x^{3}+px+q=0$ are $\alpha,\beta,\gamma$. Show that $\alpha^{3}+\beta^{3}+\gamma^{3}=-3q$.

criteria.point: Uses each root satisfies the equation

manual.title: Double root shown by the derivative
manual.prompt: Show that $x=1$ is a double root of $P(x)=x^{3}-3x+2$ and factorise $P(x)$.

manual.title: One root equal to the sum of the other two
manual.prompt: One root of $x^{3}-6x^{2}+kx-6=0$ equals the sum of the other two. Find $k$ and solve the equation.

manual.title: Reciprocal roots of a cubic
manual.prompt: The roots of $x^{3}+2x^{2}-3x-1=0$ are $\alpha,\beta,\gamma$. Find a monic cubic with roots $\tfrac1\alpha,\tfrac1\beta,\tfrac1\gamma$.

manual.title: Remainder on division by x squared minus one
manual.prompt: Find the remainder when $P(x)=x^{10}-3x+1$ is divided by (a) $x+1$ (b) $x^{2}-1$.

manual.title: Monic cubic from a quadratic remainder
manual.prompt: A monic cubic $P(x)$ leaves remainder $3x+1$ when divided by $x^{2}-3x+2$, and $P(0)=9$. Find $P(x)$.

manual.title: Product of pairwise sums of roots
manual.prompt: The roots of $P(x)=x^{3}-3x^{2}+5x-2=0$ are $\alpha,\beta,\gamma$. Show that $(\alpha+\beta)(\beta+\gamma)(\gamma+\alpha)=P(3)$ and evaluate it.

manual.title: Squared roots of a cubic without an x squared term
manual.prompt: The roots of $x^{3}-5x+3=0$ are $\alpha,\beta,\gamma$. Find the cubic with roots $\alpha^{2},\beta^{2},\gamma^{2}$.

manual.title: Coefficient when roots are in geometric sequence
manual.prompt: The three roots of $x^{3}-13x^{2}+kx-27=0$ are consecutive terms of a geometric sequence. Find the roots and the value of $k$.
hints: r = 3 or ⅓ give the same roots.
k is the sum of pair products.

ladder.method: r = 3 or ⅓ give the same roots.
ladder.worked: k is the sum of pair products.

manual.title: Dividing a quartic by x squared plus one
manual.prompt: Divide $2x^{4}-3x^{3}+x-5$ by $x^{2}+1$, writing the result as $P(x)=(x^{2}+1)Q(x)+R(x)$.

manual.title: Reciprocal sum and square sum for a quartic
manual.prompt: The roots of $x^{4}-2x^{3}+3x-1=0$ are $\alpha,\beta,\gamma,\delta$. Find $\sum\dfrac1\alpha$ and $\sum\alpha^{2}$.

manual.title: Tripling the roots of a cubic
manual.prompt: The roots of $x^{3}-3x+1=0$ are $\alpha,\beta,\gamma$. Find the monic cubic with roots $3\alpha,3\beta,3\gamma$.

manual.title: Reducing a fifth power of a root
manual.prompt: $\alpha$ is a root of $x^{3}-x-1=0$. Show that $\alpha^{5}=\alpha^{2}+\alpha+1$.

manual.title: Cubic from a surd pair and an integer root
manual.prompt: Find the monic cubic with integer coefficients whose roots are $1+\sqrt2$, $1-\sqrt2$ and $3$.

manual.title: Linear remainder from two remainders
manual.prompt: A polynomial satisfies $P(2)=5$ and $P(-1)=-1$. Find the remainder when $P(x)$ is divided by the quadratic $x^{2}-x-2$.

manual.title: Product of roots each increased by one
manual.prompt: The roots of $P(x)=x^{3}+4x^{2}+2x-3=0$ are $\alpha,\beta,\gamma$. Evaluate $(\alpha+1)(\beta+1)(\gamma+1)$ using $P(-1)$.

manual.title: Two roots with product six
manual.prompt: Two roots of $x^{3}-4x^{2}+x+6=0$ have product $6$. Find all three roots.

manual.title: Roots transformed to two alpha plus one
manual.prompt: The roots of $x^{3}-2x^{2}+3x-4=0$ are $\alpha,\beta,\gamma$. Find the monic cubic with roots $2\alpha+1$, $2\beta+1$, $2\gamma+1$.

manual.title: Quartic with a pair of opposite roots
manual.prompt: Two roots of $x^{4}+2x^{3}-7x^{2}-8x+12=0$ are $\alpha$ and $-\alpha$. Find all four roots.

manual.title: Factorising x to the fourth plus four
manual.prompt: Show that $x^{4}+4=(x^{2}+2x+2)(x^{2}-2x+2)$, and explain why $x^{4}+4$ has no real linear factors.

manual.title: Sum of squares of roots checked by solving
manual.prompt: The roots of $x^{3}-3x^{2}-x+3=0$ are $\alpha,\beta,\gamma$. Find $\alpha^{2}+\beta^{2}+\gamma^{2}$ using the coefficients, then check by solving the equation.

manual.title: Squared roots of x cubed plus x minus one
manual.prompt: The roots of $x^{3}+x-1=0$ are $\alpha,\beta,\gamma$. Find the cubic whose roots are $\alpha^{2},\beta^{2},\gamma^{2}$.
hints: Factor x from the odd terms.

ladder.nudge: Factor x from the odd terms.

manual.title: Cubic equation read from a graph
manual.prompt: The cubic shown touches the $x$-axis at $x=-1$, crosses it at $x=2$ and has $y$-intercept $-4$. Find its equation.

manual.title: Cubic with only one real root
manual.prompt: $(x-2)$ is a factor of $x^{3}+ax^{2}-4$. Find $a$ and show that the equation $x^{3}+ax^{2}-4=0$ has exactly one real root.

manual.title: Fifth powers of roots without solving
manual.prompt:
The roots of $x^{3}-x-1=0$ are $\alpha,\beta,\gamma$. Let $S_n=\alpha^{n}+\beta^{n}+\gamma^{n}$.

Show that $S_{n+3}=S_{n+1}+S_{n}$ for all integers $n\ge0$.
